result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but a loading indicator appears stuck over loaded content and horizontal carousels are awkwardly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: A loading spinner is still displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the image and restaurant details have loaded.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator as soon as the image request completes, and ensure loading state is cleared on both success and error.

issues.description: The category row ends with a thin, unlabeled portion of the next pill visible at the right edge, which looks like a cut-off UI element.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or snap position so a meaningful portion of the next category is visible, or keep the final partially visible chip out of view.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” row is heavily cropped, including its restaurant name and delivery information.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel card widths and right-side padding so the next card is either intentionally previewed or fully hidden without truncating readable text.
